# Implementation Loop Skill

Use this repeated loop for every slice: (1) clarify scope and baseline; (2) plan file-level changes; (3) write/confirm tests from ACs; (4) implement minimal code; (5) run unit/component tests; (6) run integration/contract tests; (7) lint/typecheck/build; (8) inspect diff and security/privacy implications; (9) independent review; (10) fix and rerun; (11) update traceability, defect log, phase status and changelog; (12) report evidence and request approval. Stop at first critical failure. Never claim unexecuted commands passed.
